item.title: Suspected case of bird flu detected in Co Tyrone
item.description: Disease control measures are being put in place following a suspected case of bird flu at a commercial poultry farm in County Tyrone. All poultry on site at the farm near Omagh will be culled - and a temporary control zone's being put in place. Meanwhile, the bird flu prevention zone for the whole of Northern Ireland remains in place, meaning all poultry and other captive birds legally have to be housed or kept separate from wild birds. item.description: Increases in oil and fuel prices underline the urgent need to provide the Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (CCPC) with stronger and faster enforcement powers. That's according to local Fine Gael TD, David Maxwell. Deputy Maxwell has said that while international tensions can have an impact on global oil markets, consumers are entitled to clarity, fairness and transparency when price increases are introduced with almost immediate effect. item.description: Monaghan County Council is hosting an open house for the Sean Ghardíní Affordable Purchase Scheme in Carrickmacross. 10 new affordable homes were approved at Sean Ghairdíní under the Affordable Purchase Scheme. This development consists of 4 two bedroom homes and 6 three bedroom homes. item.title: Two masked men attempt to break into Ballyconnell home
item.description: Gardai are continuing their investigations after two masked men attempted to enter a home in Ballyconnell. Gardai in Ballyconnell are appealing for information following the incident which occurred at approximately 7:30pm on the 10th of February. Gardai at the time were conducting a checkpoint in the area and were informed of an attempted burglary to a property on Main Street Ballyconnell. item.title: Removal of Virginia ATM described as 'another nail in the coffin'

The Fine Gael councillor raised the issue yesterday at the Ballyjamesduff Municipal District meeting. item.title: Brehon Brewhouse in Inniskeen set to feature on RTE TV this evening
item.description: Brehon Brewhouse in Inniskeen is set to feature on Ear to the Ground on RTE this evening. Just a few miles from the birthplace of Patrick Kavanagh, this craft ale Brewhouse is steeped in 10 generations of history at the family's dairy farm and its old stone cottages. Brehon Brewhouse was founded by dairy farmer Seamus McMahon, who wanted to diversify his family farm and so this Irish craft brewery was created. item.title: Wreath laying ceremony planned for marking of Castleblayney bombing
item.description: This Saturday marks 50 years since the Castleblayney bombing. A wreath laying ceremony will be held at the memorial in Main Street at 2pm this Saturday afternoon. The special event is to honour the victims and all those impacted by the event. The community is invited to join the remembrance. item.title: 200 new-build social homes delivered locally in 2025
item.description: 200 new-build social homes have been delivered in 2025 across the region. 119 new builds were completed in Cavan and 81 in Co Monaghan. Nationally, over 9,000 new-build social homes delivered in 2025, the highest level of delivery on record. The Minister for Housing, Local Government and Heritage James Browne TD today published the latest new-build social housing delivery statistics, revealing that 2025 was a record year for social housing construction.
